name: Upfront fee via personal UPI/QR code
description: Candidate is asked to pay a registration, training-kit, or refundable deposit fee through a personal UPI ID or QR code rather than an official company payment channel, in order to 'secure' the internship.

sources.title: Internship Offer or Scam? A Warning for College Students

name: Lookalike domain impersonating an official body
description: Offer or communication comes from a domain designed to resemble a trusted institution's official domain (e.g. swapped letters, extra words, different TLD) rather than the institution's real, published domain.

sources.title: AICTE notice on fake website URLs

name: Fake offer/appointment letter from a counterfeit official-looking email
description: An appointment or offer letter is sent from an email address designed to resemble an official institutional or corporate address, referencing a real institution's name without that institution's involvement.

sources.title: AICTE alert on fake job appointment letters sent from counterfeit domains

name: Third party falsely claiming affiliation with a reputed institute
description: An external company or training provider markets paid internships or certificate programmes as if they are run by, or partnered with, a well-known university or institute, when no such relationship exists.

sources.title: IIT Roorkee statement on unauthorised entities misusing its name

name: Artificial urgency and limited-seats pressure
description: Message emphasizes a very short deadline or a small number of remaining seats to push the candidate into paying or sharing information before they can verify the offer.

sources.title: Internship Offer or Scam? A Warning for College Students

name: Request for sensitive personal/academic data via an unofficial form
description: Candidate is directed to an unfamiliar third-party web form (not the institution's or company's own domain) to submit register numbers, phone numbers, or other academic identifiers.

sources.title: Internship Offer or Scam? A Warning for College Students
